ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio (approximately 5:95 white-to-black); the ventral surface is dominated by low-intensity dark pixels with high-intensity pixels localized only at margins and glare points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark-pixel mass covering >90% of the visible surface area; light-intensity pixels are restricted to small, high-contrast clusters at the distal tips and isolated highlights along the trailing edge topography.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 40-50 degrees; depth is shallow relative to the vertical pixel height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) across the entire boundary; the right lobe trailing edge exhibits more pronounced, irregular jaggedness compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve originating from the median notch, flattening into a neutral-to-slightly concave trajectory as it approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed, high-contrast white-and-tan pixel clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; texture is granular and protruding from the smooth fluke boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and heavy light-colored encrustation (likely barnacles) on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, creating a 'tattered' appearance.
